text: ポケモンの　だいすきな　たべものを　たべやすいように　まるめたものです。

structure.jp: ポケモンの　だいすきな　たべものを

structure.en: so that it is easy to eat
it is a thing rolled into a ball

patterns.name: 〜ように
patterns.explanation: ように says what result the action is aiming for: 'so that'. たべやすいように = 'so that it is easy to eat'.

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb stem means 'easy to do'. たべやすい = 'easy to eat'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing tells you what kind of thing it is. まるめたもの = 'something that was rolled into a ball'.
